testsuite.name: UC22 Ophthalmology Surgeries
testsuite.details: Test suite automatically generated from CLARET specifications (UFCG)

testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 (UC2) as a patient, HCP, or ophthalmologist.

step.actions: patient: The patient selects to view an ophthalmology surgery visit. They see all information the ophthalmologist HCP recorded for the surgery visit. They cannot edit the information.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.name: TC2 - Alternative Flow 1: The ophthalmologist selects to document
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 1: The ophthalmologist selects to document
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 (UC2) as a patient, HCP, or ophthalmologist.

step.actions: patient: The ophthalmologist selects to document an ophthalmology surgery by recording the patient, the date, and time of the visit.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.name: TC3 - Alternative Flow 2: A single ophthalmologist surgery appointment
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 2: A single ophthalmologist surgery appointment
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 (UC2) as a patient, HCP, or ophthalmologist.

step.actions: patient: A single ophthalmologist surgery appointment entry has the following information described in Section 22.6: Date (current date is default) Visual Acuity Results (left and right eye) Sphere (left and right eye) Cylinder (left and right eye) Axis (left and right eye) Surgery Type Notes
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.name: TC4 - Alternative Flow 3: The ophthalmologist selects to edit
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 3: The ophthalmologist selects to edit
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 (UC2) as a patient, HCP, or ophthalmologist.

step.actions: patient: The ophthalmologist selects to edit an existing ophthalmology surgery by recording the patient, the date, and time of the visit.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction
